title: Sorbet Rivière Bracelet
descriptionHtml:
Soft colour, a stone at a time. A fine tennis bracelet of round brilliant cut cubic zirconia of about 3mm in sorbet pastels, baby pink, pale lime and lilac blue, mixed along the line so the colours keep changing. Each stone sits in its own gold four claw cup, linked straight into the next, and a slim fold over clasp keeps the line flat on the wrist. Wear it with white linen in summer, or with a pastel kurta for a day function.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with white linen and one plain gold ring so the pastels lead.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 17cm
  • Stone: Round brilliant cut cubic zirconia, approximately 3mm each
  • Colours: Baby pink, pale lime and lilac blue, mixed along the line
  • Setting: Individual gold four claw cups linked directly to one another
  • Closure: Fold over clasp
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
